key_claims.claim: A co-learning NLP framework can systematically map pharmacotherapy evidence gaps for pregnant, breastfeeding, and pediatric populations across tens of millions of abstracts
Deep-learning vessel erasure from breast MRI MIPs improves radiologist-perceived lesion margin visibility, with vessels obscuring lesions in about 60 percent of cases
Multimodal AI integrating clinical, ECG, echo, CT, and cath data predicts long-term post-TAVI mortality better than existing risk scores across two international centers
The RETFound retinal foundation model matches but rarely outperforms conventional deep-learning models for retinal disease detection, even in low-label settings
MRI-guided amyloid PET reconstruction improves inter-reader agreement and Centiloid separation compared to standard OSEM reconstruction
